comparison.objective: Unlock a twist-lock extension pole, set its length to a mark, relock it, and verify it under axial load.
comparison.physical_skill: Apply a bimanual counter-torque to coaxial tubes, slide to length, reverse the twist, clear hands, and load-test; candidate instead uses a tiny hex socket and fine collar with iterative impact-response adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Requires 84–86 cm length, lock angle near the initial state, and under 2 mm shortening under 50 N for two seconds; candidate requires two acceptable dynamic stops under energy, travel, rebound, force, and drift bounds. Rubrics are numeric and complete.
comparison.reason: This is the closest workflow-level analogue—unlock, adjust, relock, verify—but it tests counter-rotation, telescoping length, and static friction-lock capacity rather than tool-mediated damping adjustment and dynamic energy absorption.
